text: いきなり　うしろがみに　かみつき　ひっぱっては　ひとの　おどろく　すがたをみて　よろこんでいる。

structure.jp: いきなり　うしろがみに　かみつき
structure.en: it suddenly bites the hair at the back of the head
and each time it yanks it

structure.jp: ひとの　おどろく　すがたをみて
structure.en: seeing how the person is startled

patterns.name: 〜ては
patterns.explanation: ては after a verb shows something done again and again, each time followed by the next thing. ひっぱっては = 'yanks it, and every time'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ひとの　おどろく　すがた
patterns.explanation: The words before すがた describe what sight it is; の here shows who does the being startled. ひとの　おどろく　すがた = 'the sight of people being startled'.

patterns.name: 〜ます stem (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut down to its ます-form without ます joins it to the next action, like 'and' in writing. かみつき = 'bites, and'.
